name: HEALTHBANE - MedDefense Coverage (post-4x02)
description: HEALTHBANE campaign ATT&CK coverage at the conclusion of project 4x02 (intelligence and threat-actor analysis). Combines IOCs from 4x00 phishing dissection, behavior from 4x01 network forensics, and HEALTHBANE attribution from HHS HC3 advisories 001-002, plus commercial threat-intel feeds. This layer represents what was KNOWN before the 4x03 malware triage and BEFORE direct on-host telemetry from the 4x04 hunt.
